title: Creation, Day by Day
lesson: God made everything good, and that includes you.
lines: Before anything existed, there was nothing. No sun, no stars, no Wi-Fi. Just darkness. And God.
Day one: God said, Let there be light. And there was light!
Day two, the sky. Day three, land, seas and plants. Trees popped up like popcorn.
Day four: sun, moon and stars. Day five: fish in the sea, and birds in the air.
Day six: animals of every kind. And then people, made in God's own image.
God looked at everything He had made, and said: it is very good.
And on day seven, God rested. Every parent watching just nodded and said, Yes. I understand that. Remember: you were made on purpose, and you are very good.
Next time: the most beautiful garden ever, and one rule. Follow so you don't miss it!
